  Features  
 Key Features 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 Full EHR System 
 
 Comprehensive patient records including encounters, vitals, SOAP notes, diagnoses, and electronic prescriptions. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Practice Management 
 
 Streamlined scheduling, appointments, waiting lists, and billing for healthcare practices of any size. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Patient Portal 
 
 Self-service portal for patients to view records, schedule appointments, and communicate with their care team. 
 
 
 
  
 
 FHIR R4 + REST API 
 
 SMART on FHIR v2.2.0 app integration with OAuth2-secured REST APIs for seamless third-party integrations. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Docker Deployment 
 
 Self-hosted or cloud-deployed via Docker. Full control over your data with enterprise-grade security. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Custom Branding 
 
 White-label ready with fully customizable frontend websites. Your clinic, your brand, your patient experience. 
 
  
 
   
 
 FAQ 
 
 
  What is Medev?     
 Medev is a rebranded instance of Medev v7.0.3+ — the world's leading open-source Electronic Health Records and Medical Practice Management system. It runs on a VPS via Docker. 
 
 
  What features does Medev include?     
 Medev includes full EHR (patient records, encounters, vitals, SOAP notes, prescriptions), practice management (scheduling, appointments, billing), patient portal, FHIR R4 + REST API with OAuth2, and SMART on FHIR v2.2.0 app integration. 
 
 
  Can I customize the patient-facing frontend?     
 Yes! Medev includes a customizable frontend website that your clinic or hospital can brand and design. You control the patient experience while the backend remains standardized with many available features and add-ons. 
 
 
  Is Medev self-hosted?     
 Yes, Medev is fully self-hosted via Docker. You have full control over your data. We also offer hosting options if you prefer us to manage it for you.
